sample_unit: colonoscopy procedures with paired histopathology reports (per cohort)

links.outcome: Guideline adherence of tool recommendations versus routine scheduling against clinician-derived reference
links.effect: Compared with observed routine practice in 127 patients, the tool would improve guideline adherence, mainly by reducing potential undersurveillance.
links.quote: The comparison to current clinical practice showed that the tool would improve guideline adherence primarily by reducing potential undersurveillance.

links.outcome: Surveillance recommendation accuracy at two NHS trusts (development site versus external site)
links.effect: Accuracy 0.96 (95% CI 0.90-0.98) at GSTT versus 0.93 (95% CI 0.86-0.97) at SWB; modest drop externally, strong class-level F1 at both sites.
links.quote: Overall surveillance recommendation accuracy was 0.96 (95% CI 0.90-0.98) at Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust (GSTT) and 0.93 (95% CI 0.86-0.97) at Sandwell and West Birmingham NHS Trust (SWB)

unlisted_practices: Hybrid architecture using LLMs for structured extraction and a deterministic guideline-encoded rule engine for decisions, yielding auditable recommendations

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM-based extraction pipeline combined with a deterministic rules engine for postpolypectomy surveillance recommendations, validating it retrospectively across two NHS centers against routine clinical scheduling.
